text:
sam: Heads up — deploy-bot just surfaced a p99 latency increase in EU-prod canary after the kernel flag change. current delta ~+15%. deploy-bot: auto-rollback threshold is 20% so no auto action yet. :eyes:

deploy-bot: ALERT: region=eu, metric=p99_latency, baseline=120ms, current=138ms, delta=15%, threshold=20% (auto-rollback=false). link: https://telemetry.redwood.prod/alerts/2619008888

kevin: link works. can we get a quick breakdown by pool? is this only on dedicated-gpu pools or host/shared?

sam: early look shows it's concentrated on dedicated-pool-eu-2 (kv-cache pressure + slightly higher tail). not global.

maya: since auto-rollback didn't kick, i'm +1 to hold traffic shift for EU and pin the release there. recommend partial rollback (eu only) instead of full revert.

jonah: agree with partial. we can route EU traffic back to release-v2.4.1 (previous kernel). plan: 1) pin canary in eu to v2.4.1 2) rollback 30% traffic slice 3) monitor 10m 

kevin: who will execute? also we should prepare a short customer note in case key tenants see anomalies.

sam: i'll run the rollback. runbook commands: ```
# pin version in EU
redwoodctl releases pin --region eu --version v2.4.1 --reason "latency-regression-canary"
# shift 30% of traffic back
redwoodctl traffic shift --region eu --from v2.4.2 --to v2.4.1 --percent 30
```

maya: tagging @oncall to watch observability dashboards and alert if p95/p99 trend doesn't improve in 10m. also prepping release-note blurb.

deploy-bot: ACTION: scheduled traffic-shift job created id=ts-2619008899, estimated completion in 30s.

sam: executing pin + shift now.

sam: pin done. shift started. deploy-bot: update: job ts-2619008899 progress=100% success=true.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: rollback-slice applied: region=eu, to_version=v2.4.1, percent=30. logs: https://deploys.redwood.prod/logs/ts-2619008899

maya: dashboards show p99 returning toward baseline (now 123ms). p95 stable. :thumbsup:

kevin: nice. sam, please file a post-mortem stub and add a changelog line noting the kernel flag risk. ticket: ENGOPS-1234

sam: will open ENGOPS-1234 and drop the comm draft into #announcements/downtime (cc: product).

jonah: follow-up ops item: run the kernel flag load test on dedicated-pool-eu-2 at scale to reproduce. schedule with perf team.

maya: closing loop — no full rollback required. manual partial rollback + pin succeeded. we'll monitor through the change window and revisit tomorrow if noise persists. :white_check_mark:
